name: 冰岛劳动力短缺工作居留
summary: 面向获得冰岛工作合同，且雇主无法在冰岛及适用欧洲劳动力市场找到人员的非欧洲经济区人员。
summaryEn: For non-EEA nationals with an Icelandic employment contract where the employer cannot recruit in Iceland or the applicable European labour market.

jobOffer.summary: 须有符合该路径要求的工作邀请、合同或雇主安排。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A job offer, contract or employer arrangement meeting the route rules is required.

qualification.summary: 职位、雇主或法律要求时，须提交适用技能、资格或专业认可证明。
qualification.summaryEn: Skill, qualification or professional-recognition evidence is required when the role, employer or law requires it.

assessment.summary: 须通过申请时适用的国籍、行业、工资、招聘、劳动力市场或其他主管机关审查。
assessment.summaryEn: Any nationality, sector, salary, recruitment, labour-market or other authority assessment in force when applying must be met.

sources.title: Work permit due to labour shortage

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
